description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the quality of patient care and foster a supportive environment for both residents and staff. You will be instrumental in upholding the highest standards of nursing practice and operational excellence.
The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong commitment to resident well-being and staff development. This role provides a chance to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards while promoting a culture of continuous improvement. We are looking for someone ready to take on this challenging yet rewarding position immediately.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Full-time MDS Coordinator to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This vital role is instrumental in ensuring accurate resident assessments and compliance with regulatory standards, directly impacting the quality of care provided to our residents. We offer a competitive hourly rate for this essential position.

The MDS Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process, including the Minimum Data Set (MDS), care plans, and resident assessments. You will play a key role in maintaining compliance with federal and state regulations, contributing to a supportive and high-quality care environment.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas (or ability to obtain)
Experience as an MDS Coordinator, preferably with MDS 3.0
Strong understanding of federal and state regulations for skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00, based on experience.
